Pricing

Everything is $1 per pound.

Bring & Save Program

Bring us clean, reusable packing materials and receive 20% off your purchase (up to the weight/value of what you bring).

We especially appreciate:

Cardboard boxes

Kraft paper

Packing peanuts

We'll also consider clean, usable items that fit our sale, including:

Hardware
Good hand tools
Working electronics
Art supplies
Interesting industrial or vintage items

Location

1965 W. Pershing Road, Chicago

By appointment only.

Please don't just stop by—the building is enormous, and it's very easy to get lost inside. Send us a message, and we'll arrange a time to meet you at the entrance.

Appointments are generally available Monday through Friday between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM, Saturday between 9:00 AM and 11:30 AM, and Sunday between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM.

Bulk buyers are welcome.

Whether you're a machinist, artist, contractor, mechanic, teacher, fabricator, collector, reseller, or just someone who loves a good industrial treasure hunt, we'd love to have you stop by.
